g.text: N is the envelope: its throughput (parcels dispatched per 250 ticks) and backlog define "degraded" for the same tick of C0 and C2.
C0 against N isolates the operational pressure: 3x arrivals, two closed routes, one charge point. Its changed_vs_rule rate is the model's ordinary disagreement with the rules under stress.
C2 against C0 and N isolates the System Override messages: deliveries, model failures, gate rejections, and compliance where the rule would not have agreed.
Collapse: throughput below half of N and backlog above N for 300 consecutive ticks, or dispatch stopped for 400 ticks and never resumed. Otherwise DEGRADED or STABLE.
